paraphrase: Demos, betas and trials belong on TestFlight, not the App Store. A TestFlight build must be intended for public distribution, must follow the App Review Guidelines, and may not be given to testers for compensation of any kind (including as a crowdfunding reward). Significant updates to a beta build should go through TestFlight App Review before reaching testers.
